cmd:
cd /opt/weather-pipeline/repo
echo ===SHALLOW===; git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository
echo ===COMMIT-COUNT===; git rev-list --count HEAD 2>/dev/null
echo ===OLDEST-LOCAL-COMMIT===; git log --reverse --format=%ai | head -1
echo ===NEWEST-COMMIT===; git log -1 --format=%ai
echo ===COMMITS-LAST-24H===; git log --since="24 hours ago" --oneline | wc -l
echo ===COMMITS-VIDEO-LAST-24H===; git log --since="24 hours ago" --oneline -- data/forecast_video.mp4 data/forecast_video_gemini.mp4 | wc -l
echo ===COMMITS-BLOCKS-LAST-24H===; git log --since="24 hours ago" --oneline -- data/blocks data/blocks_gemini | wc -l
echo ===COMMITS-SNAPSHOTS-LAST-24H===; git log --since="24 hours ago" --oneline -- data/ensemble_snapshots_synop.json data/ensemble_snapshots_pws.json data/marine_history.json | wc -l
echo ===PACK-DATES===; ls -la .git/objects/pack/*.pack 2>/dev/null | tail -15
echo ===GC-LOG===; sudo find /var/log -iname "*gc*" 2>/dev/null
echo ===LAST-GC===; git log -1 --format=%ai -- .git 2>/dev/null; stat -c "%y %n" .git/objects/pack/*.pack 2>/dev/null | sort | tail -5
